base_protocol.source_posterior: leave-one-material-out task_directed policy after one selected logged shake probe
base_protocol.target_conditioning: one-second target prefix plus recorded driven-corner boundary

claim_boundary: The experiment can test whether source-derived quotient probabilities predict held-out twisting response classes and whether same-quotient complete beliefs expose different latent specificity and decisions. It cannot establish exact material identity, global physical identifiability, online intervention value, safety, fresh confirmation, or state of the art.
evidence_class: retrospective public-real-data shake-to-twist query-quotient validation; source and selection protocol predate first target scoring, wrapper added after prior target exposure; no fresh-confirmation claim

query.observation_assignment: nearest sealed class-center final RMS displacement
query.partition_rule: stable sort of model-predicted final free-marker RMS displacement; three contiguous equal-count finite-diameter classes
query.reference_state: sealed causal target state at prefix cutoff
